releases.notes: # falcraft v1.0.0 AI-powered 3D structure generation for Minecraft! ## Features ### 🏰 3D Structure Generation - `/fal generate ` - Generate 3D structures (~30 seconds) - `/fal generate legacy ` - High-quality Meshy-6 mode (~6 minutes) - Ghost block preview with rotation (G) and placement (right-click) - Size options: 16-128 blocks ### 🎨 Texture Remixing *(Coming soon)* - `/fal remix ` - Point at any block and remix its texture - Creates a custom resource pack with your remixed textures - The plan is to add better utility, i.e. history, undo/redo functionality etc ### ⚙️ Configuration - `/fal setkey ""` - Configure your fal.ai API key in-game (make sure to wrap it in the quote marks!) - `/fal status` - Check configuration status --- ## 👤 For Players ### Requirements - **Minecraft 1.21.1** - **Fabric Loader 0.18.1** (or newer) - **Fabric API 0.116.7+1.21.1** (or newer) ### Installation #### Step 1: Install Fabric Loader 1. Download [Fabric Installer](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) 2. Run it and select **Minecraft Version: 1.21.1** 3. Click **Install** #### Step 2: Download Mods - [Fabric API 0.116.7+1.21.1](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/version/0.116.7+1.21.1) - [Falcraft 1.0.0](https://github.com/blendi-remade/falcraft/releases/latest) #### Step 3: Install Mods 1. Open `.minecraft/mods` folder: - **Windows**: Press `Win+R`, type `%appdata%\.minecraft\mods`, press Enter - **Mac**: `~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/mods` - **Linux**: `~/.minecraft/mods` 2. Put both downloaded JAR files in this folder #### Step 4: Set Up Your API Key 1. Launch Minecraft (select the Fabric profile) 2. Join any world 3. Run (with quotes!): `/fal setkey "your-api-key-here"` 4. Get your API key: https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys **That's it!** Try: `/fal generate 48 medieval castle` --- ### Troubleshooting - **Crash on startup?** Make sure you have Minecraft **1.21.1** (not 1.21.10) - **Command not working?** Check `/fal status` - wrap your API key in quotes when setting - **Still having issues?** [Open an issue](https://github.com/blendi-remade/falcraft/issues) with your crash log --- ## 🛠️ For Developers ### Building from Source 1. git clone https://github.com/blendi-remade/falcraft 2. cd falcraft 3. ./gradlew build ### Development Setup 1. Create `run/.env` and add your API key: `FAL_API_KEY=your_key_here ` 2. Run: `./gradlew runClient` ### Tech Stack - Fabric API 0.107.0+1.21.1 - Fabric Loom 1.12 - Java 21 --- ## License CC0 1.0 - Public Domain
